full_text: Intro Encompass® Training and Support We understand the unique demands of the mortgage industry, and that’s why we’ve designed specialized Encompass training programs for professionals across different roles. Whether you’re a loan processor, MLO, underwriter, or escrow officer, our comprehensive courses cater to your specific needs. Choose Awesome Technologies for Encompass 360 coaching and training that goes the extra mile to ensure your team’s success. Full Name Email Contact No. Message Page URL Home » Encompass® Training and Support Encompass® Training for Staff and Admins Our training goes beyond the basics, providing in-depth knowledge and practical skills to empower your team. With our training, participants will delve into the depth of Encompass LOS, gaining expertise in utilizing input forms, tools, e-folder functionality, and communication methods. Our objective is straightforward: eradicate any uncertainty linked to using Encompass and provide your team with the assurance to navigate the loan software effortlessly. By the end of our training, your staff and admins will understand Encompass like seasoned experts and be well-prepared to tackle the challenges of the mortgage industry. Customized Training Programs Our training is designed exclusively for mortgage companies. We understand the unique nature of each mortgage business and have developed a customizable training program to meet your distinct needs seamlessly. Our Custom Training goes beyond generic solutions. We offer personalized training modules tailored to your company’s Encompass instance. Whether it’s refining the expertise of loan originators, underwriters, or administrative personnel, our Encompass training sessions and courses are designed to adapt to the unique requirements of each role in mortgage lending. Our Encompass Training Is Targeted Towards Loan Officers Mortgage Brokers Loan Processors Mortgage Underwriters Loan Originators Mortgage Consultants Escrow Officers Loan Servicers Compliance Officers Our Encompass® Staff & Admin Training Revolve Around 6 Steps Identifying user roles to create unique training We help your team by breaking down each person's job and the steps they need to do it. We encourage role-specific training because it helps your team remember things better when they learn in small steps. Reviewing your current procedures We also study your current task execution methods and strategies to ensure we are on the same page. If we spot any major differences, we will discuss regarding it. Finding the real challenges We determine what causes headaches so that we can focus on those bits during training. This way, we can help your team overcome obstacles, which means less frustration and fewer mistakes. Staying at forefront of upgrades We are constantly evolving with technological advancements. This helps us make sure we're giving you the most recent and future-proof info. Interactive training sessions Our admins conduct engaging and interactive training sessions and encourage hands-on practice to reinforce learning. We encourage users to ask questions and seek clarification. Ongoing support We are proud to offer ongoing support and resources for users post-training. This means you always have a helping hand, even after the training is over. On-site or Remote Training From Certified Experts Making sure your team knows how to use Encompass well is essential for success with the Encompass 360. At Awesome Technologies, we’ve been working with Encompass for a long time and know what kind of help mortgage professionals need with this loan origination system. Our Encompass360 training is sorted for different groups and skill levels. You can choose between on-site or online training, whatever works best for you. We focus on helping with tasks like data entry, regulations, and business rules. Training is key to getting the most out of your Encompass mortgage software. We Help You Become an Encompass Certified Administrator With our comprehensive training programs, we go beyond equipping you with essential skills in mortgage lending. We specialize in guiding your team to obtain Encompass Administrator Certification. Our tailored curriculum ensures that you excel in your day-to-day tasks and gain the expertise needed to navigate Encompass effectively. Whether you’re a mortgage professional or just starting, our programs are designed to empower you with the knowledge and certification essential for success as an Encompass Administrator. Uplift your career with us and showcase your expertise with the Encompass Administrator Certification. WE MASTER EVERYTHING ENCOMPASS® Whether you’re venturing into Encompass® for the first time or seeking to refine your current configuration, count on us for exceptional solutions Our Hand-Crafted Plugins & Solutions Make Your Encompass® Instance Better EXPLORE ALL AN ABUNDANCE OF TECHNOLOGICAL DELIGHTS Discover the transformative power of these incredible tools that fit into your loan-originating system. Built with security and compliance in mind, our plugins adhere to industry standards to safeguard sensitive loan data.
